    "Model forecasts lag behind price turning points, especially at market bottoms where true outcomes decline faster than predicted.",
    "When sentiment turns positive, model forecasts undershoot true prices due to delayed price momentum absorption.",
    "Mean reversion bias exists in both forecasts and true outcomes, with ranges converging to the 70-75 EUR/MT liquidity zone.",
    "Sentiment positivity correlates with muted price declines and accelerated rebounds when sentiment turns negative.",
    "Model overestimates price support levels during downward trends, particularly for 5-10 day horizons.",
    "Price volatility increases when sentiment fluctuates, causing forecast deviations from smoothed true outcomes.",
    "Lag effect intensifies at market inflection points where sentiment shifts abruptly" ]
